limits: Development evidence; actual VoiceOver/full RC, minimum-iOS17 rendering, measured contrast, physical play and frame pacing remain unverified.
Native stills and assertions do not establish continuous motion quality. The earlier sampled normal-motion recording retains its original d057696 source.
Static reviewers use authored shells rather than native LivingLight shader output.
Publication and canonical installation require their own exact-source receipt.
nonProductFailures: The compact native tests passed 2/2 with zero failures/skips, but the temporary export selection expected the conditional Places recovery attachment. The actual passing branch used the map. File-only correction indexed that existing exact attachment; original failed export record and PNGs are retained unchanged. No Apple rerun or assertion change.

First clean-export helper invocation used tarfile.extractall(filter=...) on the system Python version lacking that keyword; it failed before comparison. The bundled Python completed the unchanged helper and all 76 files/fingerprint match.

One Git blob upload assembled too few base64 chunks and returned a different SHA. The SHA gate rejected it; the orphan blob is not used in any tree. Correct complete bytes were reuploaded and matched their local Git SHAs.
